key_path: Have an Amazon.com account (email + phone OTP; 2FA mandatory for Seller Central).
Gather business registration number, government ID/passport, recent bank or credit-card statement.
Sign in to Solution Provider Portal -> Register -> enroll -> 'Build applications that use SP APIs'.
Verify identity: business info, PIN via SMS/call + CAPTCHA, upload documents, live VIDEO call with an Amazon associate.
Create developer profile (use case, roles; restricted roles need security/data-protection docs) -> review.
Register a Sandbox app client (allowed while profile is under review) -> get LWA client id/secret -> first sandbox call.
Production: self-authorize a private app (refresh token) after profile approval; public apps need full security review + Appstore listing.
Seller shortcut (no dev registration): add Claude connector https://sellingpartner-ai.amazon.com/mcp -> OAuth via sellercentral.amazon.com/apps/agents/authorize (requires an existing seller account).

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes (CIMD) for the remote Selling Partner MCP - AS metadata has client_id_metadata_document_supported:true, PKCE S256, token endpoint api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token
agent_native_auth.sandboxes: yes - SP-API sandbox apps usable before profile approval
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes - role-based (restricted vs unrestricted roles), LWA refresh tokens
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes as of Oct 2026 - the announced $1,400/yr subscription + GET-call fees were reportedly cancelled on 2026-05-12 (secondary sources; verify)

remote.name: Amazon Selling Partner MCP
remote.auth: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE via Seller Central, CIMD; added to Claude directory Sept 2026

local: @amazon-sp-api-release/sp-api-dev-mcp v1.0.5 (npm, Aug 2026): sp-api-dev-assistant (docs search, endpoint catalog, live execute, codegen, migration) + sp-api-workflow MCP. Labeled 'example, not a supported product'. Docs tools need no credentials.
mcp.directories: Claude: 'Amazon Selling Partner' (Anthropic verified, Made by Amazon). No consumer-shopping MCP; Amazon Ads MCP in open beta since Feb 2026 (secondary).
agentic_commerce_protocols: None open to third-party agents. First-party only: Rufus/'Buy for Me' (buys on non-Amazon sites), Alexa+ / 'Alexa for Shopping' (reported). Amazon v. Perplexity Comet injunction (Mar 2026, reported) - hostile to outside shopping agents.

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: yes - developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/llms.txt (1,258 lines); links use the new developer-docs.amazon domain (resolves). Pages carry `agentTools: siteIndex/projectIndex` front-matter.
docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - every doc has a .md version
docs_for_agents.openapi: yes - SP-API models published (selling-partner-api-models on GitHub)
docs_for_agents.build_with_ai: partial - local-ai-sandbox + MCP samples in amzn/selling-partner-api-samples
docs_for_agents.robots_ai_stance: amazon.com robots.txt: Disallow / for GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, meta-externalagent, CCBot - the most hostile in this batch

score_justification: Excellent agent-oriented docs and a new CIMD-based seller MCP, but developer onboarding needs KYC + a live video ID call, and the consumer storefront actively blocks every AI user-agent.
best_practice: Doc pages advertise their llms.txt indexes in front-matter (agentTools), and the remote seller MCP lets an existing seller skip developer registration entirely.
biggest_gap: Video-call identity verification for developers; consumer side closed to third-party agents (robots + litigation) while Amazon pushes its own agents.
